name: features-bento
title: Bento features
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: An asymmetric grid of related features with one large tile, wide and tall tiles, accent and outline tones, and whole-tile links.

meta.useWhen: Four to seven related capabilities differ in importance, and one deserves the largest tile.
meta.avoidWhen: The items are unrelated, equal in weight, or exactly three. A bento grid of unrelated boxes reads as filler; use features-editorial.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/FeaturesBento.astro. Give the most important item size large.
